content.text:
The researcher reduced review days from 60 to 30 and added SYN-PAT-026 as university background IP. I should accept the patent ring-fence but push back on review days - 30 days may be too short for us to assess confidential information. I can trade: accept 30 days review in exchange for something, or push for 60 days. Let me think about what matters most to us.

Our key interests: confidentiality of data/know-how, usable results, timeline. The 30-day review is a concern for protecting confidential information. I can accept 30 days but ensure companyMayRemoveConfidential stays true. The SYN-PAT-026 ring-fence is fine as background IP - as long as the results we commission are still company-owned.
Since 30 days still lets us remove confidential info, it's workable, but I have one more round left (round 3 of 4) so I want to push for a bit more. I'll accept the SYN-PAT-026 background IP ring-fence as reasonable, and since 45 isn't an allowed value, I'll propose going back to our original 60-day review window while conceding everything else.
